minigamebots.control.ai_on: AI in control (%s). F8 to take over, F9 to stop.
minigamebots.control.emergency_stop: Emergency stop: AI released all keys. You're in control.
minigamebots.debug.script_started: Running test script (%s ticks). F9 stops it.
minigamebots.debug.no_events: No events yet. Events are detected while the AI is in control or with /mgb watch on.
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.title: MinigameBots Settings
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.humaniz: Keeps the AI's input within human limits. Only turn this off for debugging.
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.reactio: Average delay between the AI deciding something and doing it.
How much the reaction time varies from moment to moment.
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.maxTurn: Fastest the AI can move the camera.
How quickly camera turns can speed up and slow down. Lower looks smoother and more human.
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.aimNois: Small, smooth imperfection in aim, like a real hand on a mouse.
Clicks allowed in any one-second window.
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.keepRun: Don't pause the game when the window loses focus while the AI is in control.
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.aiFrame: Frame rate while the AI is in control, even when minimized. Lower is quieter and cooler.
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.guiCurs: How far the AI's cursor moves in menus per degree of mouse movement.
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.fairPer: The AI only knows what a human could see or hear: no seeing through walls.
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.frameSi: Size of the square image the AI sees. 128 matches the pretrained models.
minigamebots.recorder.title: Recorder
minigamebots.recorder.failed: Something went wrong. See the log.
minigamebots.recorder.import_none: Put .mgbrec files in the import folder, then press Import.
minigamebots.recorder.name: Name
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.recordi: JPEG quality of recorded frames. 90 keeps detail at about 100-300 MB per hour.
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.maxReco: A recording stops by itself after this long.
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.showRec: Small REC badge in the corner while recording.
minigamebots.brain.title: Brain
minigamebots.brain.own_python_help: Full path to a Python 3.10+ executable, e.g. C:\Python312\python.exe. The brain gets its own environment built from it; your Python itself isn't changed. Leave empty to download a standalone Python instead.
minigamebots.brain.not_installed: Not installed yet. Install (GPU) for NVIDIA cards (about 4-5 GB), or Install (CPU).
minigamebots.foundations.button_help: Download pretrained foundation models (VPT) that AIs can be trained on top of.
minigamebots.foundations.help: A foundation already knows basic Minecraft from 70,000 hours of video. It's downloaded once and shared by every AI trained on it.
minigamebots.foundations.remove_help: Deletes the download. AIs trained on it can't play until it's installed again.
minigamebots.brain.stopped_ai: The brain stopped. You're in control.
minigamebots.profiles.title: AI Profiles
minigamebots.profiles.none_active: No AI selected yet. Make one with the + card.
minigamebots.profiles.delete_message: '%s' and everything it learned will be deleted for good. Export it first to keep a copy.
minigamebots.profiles.import_none: Put .mgbot files in the import folder, then press Import.
minigamebots.brain.update_help: Installs packages a newer version of the mod needs, without reinstalling everything.
minigamebots.training.title: Training
minigamebots.training.no_recordings: No recordings yet. Press F7 and play for a few minutes; the AI learns to do what you did.
minigamebots.training.base_help: Lite: a small network learned from scratch, fast on any PC, uses everything the mod perceives. VPT: starts from a foundation model that already knows basic Minecraft and learns from the picture only; needs a GPU. Install foundations in Brain > Foundations.
minigamebots.training.plan_help: How long to train. More steps learn more but take longer. Quick try is for checking everything works; Overnight for real results.
minigamebots.training.resources_help: Quiet keeps the PC cooler and quieter but trains slower; Max is fastest (best overnight).
minigamebots.training.fresh_help: Forget what this AI learned before and start over. Leave it off to keep improving it.
minigamebots.training.play_help: Give control to this AI using what it has learned so far. F9 takes control back.
minigamebots.training.needs_brain: Set up the brain first: F10 > Brain > Install.
minigamebots.training.help: Pick recordings that show what to learn, then press Start. Moments marked as mistakes are skipped.
yacl3.config.minigamebots:config.predict: How a trained AI picks actions: 0 = human-like variety (like the recordings), 1 = always its single best guess.
minigamebots.practice.button_help: Let the AI improve itself by trying, guided by an Objective (rewards and penalties).
minigamebots.practice.objective_help: What counts as doing well. Ready-made ones, or your own (made with Edit).
minigamebots.practice.edit_help: Change the rules. Editing a ready-made Objective saves your own copy in this AI.
minigamebots.practice.human_help: How strongly to keep the style it learned from your recordings. Higher = more human, lower = freer to find its own tricks.
minigamebots.practice.help: Practice works best in Training Grounds matches set to keep going: each round is one try, and win/loss counts. It also works anywhere else (each death ends a try). It saves as it goes; the version that plays normally only changes when practice scores better.
minigamebots.objective.per_help: Count each time it happens, or multiply by a number from the event (e.g. damage amount).
minigamebots.objective.tier_help: Priority T1 (most important) to T4. While a more important rule is in play, penalties from less important ones count less.
minigamebots.objective.forgive_help: Hold a penalty back for 20 s and cancel it if it gets a kill or wins: so it learns to take hits when that's how it wins.
minigamebots.objective.cap_help: Most this rule can add up to in one round (empty = no limit). Stops it farming one thing.
minigamebots.objective.cooldown_help: Seconds before this rule can count again.
minigamebots.objective.budget_help: Budget: this much is free each round; above it, it costs more and more each round it's broken. Use with a positive value = cost per unit.
minigamebots.objective.help: Each rule: an event (kill, damage_taken, death, tg_episode_end, second, ...), when it counts (e.g. target=minecraft:pig, result=win, amount>=2), and what it's worth. Events from Training Grounds start with tg_. See /mgb events for names.
minigamebots.exams.start_help: The AI plays the next rounds of the Training Grounds match running now, as it normally plays, and the results are saved.
minigamebots.exams.help: Start a Training Grounds match set to keep going, then start the exam here. Compare results after more training to see what helps.
minigamebots.memory.mark_type_help: What kind of place to mark where you stand.
minigamebots.memory.pin_help: Pinned places are never forgotten or moved by the AI.
minigamebots.memory.auto_help: Whoever hits the AI (or the person it protects) is remembered as an enemy, and so is everyone wearing the same insignia.
minigamebots.memory.trust_help: Which signal decides when they disagree: a remembered name, the scoreboard team (tab/name colour) or the insignia (shield pattern, banner, dyed armour).
minigamebots.memory.factions_empty: Nobody remembered yet. Players and insignias are added when they attack the AI (if that's on), or appear here once marked. Same insignia as yours counts as an ally automatically.
minigamebots.memory.none: Choose an AI (AI Profiles > Use this AI) and join a world to see what it remembers here.
minigamebots.versions.button_help: Earlier versions of this AI, saved automatically before each training or practice session. Go back to one in one click.
minigamebots.versions.revert_help: Make this the AI's current version. The version it has now is saved first, so this can be undone.
minigamebots.versions.pin_help: Pinned versions are never deleted automatically (only the last 10 are kept otherwise).
minigamebots.versions.empty: No saved versions yet. One is saved automatically before every training or practice session.
minigamebots.goals.free_help: When the goals run out (or there are none), the AI does what it feels like: goes home at night, finds food when hungry, otherwise picks what it likes (the sliders).
minigamebots.training.skill_help: Which skill to train. Each skill is its own trained network; the Manager (Goals) picks the right one for each goal. "general" is the AI's main one, used when a skill isn't trained.
minigamebots.profiles.merge_help: Make a new AI from this one and another, choosing which AI each skill comes from.
minigamebots.merge.help: Makes a new AI. The two you merge from stay as they are.
minigamebots.teacher.button_help: Record a scripted expert playing as this AI, to train on. No skill needed from you.
minigamebots.teacher.help: A scripted expert plays through the AI's own keys and mouse (with its human limits) while the recorder runs. The recording then appears in the list here: tick it and train, like any recording.
minigamebots.teacher.tip_grounds: Tip: start a Training Grounds match first (e.g. against a league or godly opponent) so every round is recorded.
minigamebots.teacher.tip_alone: Tip: it fights the nearest player, hostile mob or training dummy. With Training Grounds you get arenas, opponents and instant resets.
minigamebots.training.aim_drill_help: Also learn aiming, tracking and chasing in a tiny built-in simulator (very fast). Lite base only; works even with no recordings.
minigamebots.realism.help: A critic learns to tell your own recordings from AI play; during practice the AI gets a small reward for input that looks human, and for the style you pick below. It can also copy how fast and smoothly you turn.
minigamebots.realism.analyze_help: Train the critic and style model from all recordings and your picks, and measure your turning. Takes seconds.
minigamebots.realism.apply_help: Set this AI's turn speed, acceleration and aim wobble to what was measured from your play.
minigamebots.realism.compare_help: Watch two short clips of the AI and pick the better or more human one. Press Analyze afterwards.
minigamebots.compare.help: Pick the clip that plays better or looks more human
minigamebots.video.help: Put Minecraft gameplay videos in the videos folder. The AI keeps first-person gameplay, guesses the keys and mouse, and learns from it (weighted below your own recordings). Tags group what it learns about a server or modpack.
minigamebots.video.import_help: Turn the selected video into training recordings and questions.
minigamebots.video.idm_help: Learn to guess keys and mouse from pictures, using your recordings (which have the real inputs). Do this first, and again after recording more.
minigamebots.video.atlas_help: Save every item's icon as your game shows it (resource packs included), so videos' hotbar items can be recognised.
minigamebots.video.share_help: Export your Knowledge Books to videolab/exports as .mgbkb files, and import any .mgbkb put in videolab/import.
